listed_sector_signals.signal: Hydrogen is mentioned as a possible future CHP fuel; hydrogen production is not described.
listed_sector_signals.quote:
Natural gas is seen as an interim solution - with the possibility of a future switch to biogas or
hydrogen.

other_continuous_flow_signals.signal: Proposed natural-gas cogeneration units serving the base heat load.
other_continuous_flow_signals.quote:
To cover the base heat load, several small CHP units (~10 MWt / ~10 MWe in total) are planned
to be built, running on natural gas as a transitional fuel.

other_continuous_flow_signals.signal: District heating loops with decentralized heat pumps and potential industrial waste-heat recovery.
other_continuous_flow_signals.quote:
The fifth generation (SGDHC) goes
even further, with ambient mains temperatures (often 10-30 °C) and decentralised heat pumps at
each site, including the ability to recover cooling and waste heat from industrial or domestic
processes.

other_continuous_flow_signals.signal: Illustrative seasonal energy-balance calculations for the proposed CHP district heating system.
other_continuous_flow_signals.quote:
The presented values result from a seasonal energy
balance calculated according to ISO 50006 methodology, using normalized energy performance
indicators and baseline comparison.

one_line: Conceptual modernization of residential and public-building heating in Orlandovtsi using proposed CHP, district heating, renewables, storage and ISO 50001, with illustrative ISO 50006 seasonal calculations.
